title: Show HN: We cut our flaky-test rate by tagging non-deterministic failures automatically
excerpt: We built a small CI plugin that re-runs a failed test once, and if it passes the second time, tags it flaky instead of failed. Cut our false-red builds by about a third in the first month.

title: Tests failing randomly again — anyone else re-running CI 3x a day just to get a green build?
excerpt: Our suite has maybe 15 tests that fail maybe 1 in 20 runs for no reason anyone's found. Nobody trusts a single red build anymore, everyone just reruns and moves on. Feels like a ticking time bomb.

title: Flaky Tests Cost More Than You Think: A 2026 Survey of 400 Engineering Teams
excerpt: We surveyed 400 teams and found the median team loses 6.5 engineering hours per week to re-running CI builds because of flaky tests — not because the code was actually broken.
